Hello — I’m Sergio Uribe.

I build communities through language.

Colombian educator focused on connection, curiosity, and real conversation. I work with young people as a Spanish teacher and keep coming back to the same idea: language is a way of letting other people into your experience.

Projects and fieldwork will appear here as this season takes shape.
